description: Verify the harness itself: heredoc transfer, CPYFRMSTMF into QRPGSRC, CRTRPGPGM (OPM RPG III, matching the technique Part 5 needs), and whether CHGJOB INQMSGRPY(*DFT) auto-answers the RPG0102 divide-by-zero inquiry instead of hanging. Intended as the very first real connection before Part 5 work starts (execution plan step 1). ccsid is intentionally left unset on the file step: CPYFRMSTMF will use the stream file's own CCSID tag, since no prior session in this repo recorded which CCSID a heredoc-written file actually gets tagged with over this exact SSH/qsh path. If this run shows CPYFRMSTMF picked the wrong CCSID (garbled compile), the fix is to add an explicit ccsid candidate here and retry in the next connection - not to guess one now.
